correctness.rationale: The self-contained exact Python checker exhaustively enumerates each of the five edge-subset complexes and independently checks the forbidden-triple membership condition, constructs full pairwise acyclic matchings, topologically sorts every directed Hasse incidence, computes signed integral Morse differentials, and checks the required unit minors. Critical-cell counts and matrices are in RESULT.md. Morse cancellation then proves the exact integral homotopy types, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: The exact homotopy data on the first five canonical cubic Möbius ladders identifies a sharp and counterintuitive nonsingle-sphere case at n=6 and reversion at n=7, complementing known periodic results on distinct associated complexes. The natural object and its integral homotopy are independently motivated, and the finite cutoff captures the first failure and recovery rather than an arbitrary selected invariant.
